refuted.finding: The banner copy opens with a label-style lead, 'Offline:', followed by a lowercase clause, 'no package source knows this version.'. A message should be whole sentences in sentence case, and 'Offline' also misnames the condition the clause describes (no source knows this version).
refuted.reason: The crop reads 'Offline: no package source knows this version. These details come from the package cache on this machine.', which is two sentence-case sentences each ending with a period, so DS-COPY-3 (whole sentences ending with '.') holds; the objection to the 'Offline:' lead and its wording is taste with no rule behind it (rubric §6).
